definition_zh: 隐秘贮藏处；贮藏物；（计算机）高速缓存；隐藏贮存
definition_en: a hidden store of goods or data; as a verb, to store or hide away
core_image: 树根下埋着的一只铁皮箱，装着猎人的补给
scene: 猎人在老松树的根下挖出一只锈迹斑斑的铁箱。The trapper kept a cache of supplies by the river.
sceneCN: 这里 cache 是「隐秘贮藏物」（第 1 个义项：暗中存放的补给）；句意是猎人在河边藏了一批补给品。

pos.zh: 隐藏的贮藏物；秘密贮藏处；（计算机）高速缓存

derivatives.zh: 由法语 diminutive 而来，义为「小型藏匿处」
由 geo- 加 cache 构成的复合词，义为「地理藏宝点」
同源近形词，义为「现金」，与 cache 发音相同

senses.title: A hidden store of goods
senses.definition: a secret store of supplies or valuables hidden away for later use
senses.definitionCN: 为日后取用而秘密藏起的物资或财物
senses.example: Soldiers found a cache of rifles in the barn.
senses.exampleCN: 士兵在谷仓里发现一批私藏的步枪。
senses.why: The French word for a hiding place named the things hidden there.
senses.whyCN: 法语的「藏匿处」一词转指藏起来的东西。

senses.title: A fast computer memory
senses.definition: a small, fast memory that keeps copies of frequently used data
senses.definitionCN: 保存常用数据副本的小型高速存储器
senses.example: Clearing the browser cache fixed the slow loading.
senses.exampleCN: 清掉浏览器缓存后，加载变快了。
senses.why: Computing borrowed the image of a small store kept close at hand.
senses.whyCN: 计算机术语借用了「近旁小库」这一意象。

senses.title: To store or hide away
senses.definition: to put something in a hidden store, literally or in computing
senses.definitionCN: 把某物藏入密藏处，计算领域指存入缓存
senses.example: The rebels cached their ammunition in caves.
senses.why: The noun of the store becomes the verb of storing.
senses.whyCN: 贮藏物的名词转为贮藏的动词。

intro.en: Cache comes from French cacher, to hide, whose deeper root is the Latin coacticare, to press together.
intro.cn: cache 源自法语 cacher（隐藏），更深的词根是拉丁语 coacticare（压紧收拢）。

items.en: coacticare meant to press or force together, from coactus, compelled.
items.cn: 拉丁语 coacticare 意为「压紧、收拢」，出自 coactus（被迫的）。

items.en: cachier and cacher meant to press, then to hide away.
items.cn: 古法语 cachier、cacher 由「压紧」转指「藏匿」。

items.en: cache named a hiding place, especially for furs and supplies.
items.cn: 法语名词 cache 指藏匿处，尤指皮货与补给的存放点。

items.en: fur traders and explorers brought cache into English for hidden stores.
items.cn: 十八至十九世纪皮货商与探险家把 cache 带入英语，指密藏的物资。

items.en: computer engineers adopted cache for a small fast store of data.
items.cn: 二十世纪计算机工程师借 cache 指小型高速数据存储。

note.en: The look-alike group separates the homophone cash; the near-meaning group gives storing and hiding words.
note.cn: 形近组区分同音词 cash；近义组是贮藏与隐藏类词。

entries.definition: money in coins or notes, from the same French cacher via a case for money
entries.definitionCN: 现金，同出法语 cacher（原指钱匣）

entries.definition: prestige, from a seal on a document
entries.definitionCN: 威望，同根词，源自印章义
抓住，仅拼写相近，词源无关

entries.definition: a hidden container found by GPS
entries.definitionCN: 地理藏宝点，cache 的现代复合词

entries.definition: a carefully saved and hidden store
a temporary data store in computing

normalIntro.en: Same sound as cash: a cache is a hidden pile of value.
normalIntro.cn: 与 cash 同音：cache 就是藏起来的那份「财」。

normal.cn: 法语 cacher 意为隐藏。

normal.en: A cache of weapons is a hidden pile of guns.
normal.cn: a cache of weapons 指一批私藏的枪支。

normal.en: Clear the cache is the common computing phrase.
normal.cn: clear the cache 是常见的计算机用语。

normal.en: Cachet shares the root but means prestige.

abstract.en: See dirt brushing off a tin box under roots.
abstract.cn: 看树根下铁皮箱上的泥土被拂去。

abstract.en: Feel the weight of coins hidden in a floor cavity.
abstract.cn: 感受地板暗格中钱币的分量。

abstract.en: Picture files sliding into a small drawer the CPU keeps open.
abstract.cn: 想象文件滑入处理器身旁常开的小抽屉。

examples.en: Police uncovered a cache of stolen paintings.
examples.cn: 警方起获一批窝藏的失窃名画。

examples.en: The app caches images so pages load faster.
examples.cn: 这款应用会缓存图片，使页面加载更快。

examples.en: Hikers kept a cache of dried food along the trail.
examples.cn: 徒步者在沿途藏了些干粮。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作 cash「现金」——藏起来的现金，正是「密藏之物」；电脑里的小金库就是缓存。

root: cache 源自拉丁语 coacticare「压紧、收拢」，经古法语 cacher「藏匿」进入英语；名词指密藏之物与藏匿处，二十世纪又进入计算机术语，指贴近处理器的高速小存储。

sensesIntro.en: One idea of the hidden store serves hunters, soldiers, and computer chips alike.
sensesIntro.cn: 「暗藏的一库」这一个意象，同时服务于猎人、士兵与计算机芯片。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tin box buried under tree roots.
core.cn: 核心意象：埋在树根下的铁皮箱。

branches.en: a cache of rifles in the barn
a trapper's food cache by the river

branches.cn: 为快速加载而缓存的数据

branches.en: to cache is to bury the cache
branches.cn: 动词「藏」与名词「藏物」一体

intro.en: Cache is a bare French noun; its family all circle the idea of pressing or hiding.
intro.cn: cache 是光杆法语名词；其同族词都围绕「压紧、隐藏」之意。

latinIntro.en: Latin coacticare, to press together, is the deep root, from coactus, compelled.
latinIntro.cn: 深层词根是拉丁语 coacticare「压紧」，出自 coactus「被迫的」。
